human_iaa_audit.decision: Track B V2 expansion archived/blocked after failing 0/5 human IAA gates; production strictly serves untouched Track A V1.

architecture_comparison.benchmark_protocol: Apples-to-apples 5-fold group-aware CV evaluation across all 5 tasks on identical trainval (n=367) / untouched frozen held-out test (n=92, 37 unseen threads) of 459 curated real Reddit comments (seed=20261116, 0 synthetic rows, 0/44 test-thread DAPT overlap). Auxiliary 54-probe stress scores are observational only.

why_transformer.selected_architecture: Track A Strictly-Inductive 5-Fold Pure Neural (MuRIL-DAPT-WWM-8ep + XLM-RoBERTa-base on Solution)

key_reasons.title: Zero-leakage strictly inductive Track A breakthrough (0 synthetic data)
key_reasons.evidence: Trained strictly via 5-fold group-aware CV on 367 real comments and evaluated once on the untouched frozen 92-comment (37-thread) held-out test set: Deployed Track A reaches 65.6% mean Macro F1 (MuRIL-WWM 63.0%) vs. 5-fold LogReg 49.9%, ANN 43.6%, and CNN 42.1% — beating transductive V5 (59.5%) by +6.1 pp with zero test-thread leakage.

key_reasons.title: Statistically significant gains on Issue & Solution (paired bootstrap p >= 0.99)
key_reasons.evidence: Native [CLS] reply [SEP] parent_or_title [SEP] context + Asymmetric Loss lifted Issue from 45.7% -> 60.8% (breaking 0.00 F1 on academic_workload & curriculum_teaching), while OOF-selected XLM-RoBERTa-base (zero DAPT) lifted Solution from 76.1% -> 84.6%.

key_reasons.title: Strictly inductive Whole-Word Masking (WWM) DAPT (0/44 test overlap)
key_reasons.evidence: Excluding all 44 frozen-test & same-title threads (749 comments), 8-epoch ##-aligned WWM MLM on 2,135 unlabeled Reddit texts reduced unseen thread-grouped validation perplexity from 88.319 -> 25.234 on 347 disjoint unseen texts.

key_reasons.title: OOF Per-Label Platt + Native 5-Fold Calibration & Honest Human IAA Gate
key_reasons.evidence: Monotonic OOF Platt calibration on multi-label ASL heads + native 5-fold logit averaging yields mean held-out 5-bin ECE 0.059 (T >= 1.0). A 50-item blind human IAA audit on Track B V2 failed 0/5 gates, so V2 stays archived and production serves strictly verified Track A V1.
